schema_notes.rack_unit_note: 1U = 1.75 inches (44.45mm) of vertical rack space. 4U = 7 inches. All chassis listed mount in standard 19-inch EIA-310 racks.
schema_notes.depth_note: Internal usable depth (GPU clearance depth) is less than external chassis depth. Always verify internal GPU clearance depth against GPU length_mm from the GPU catalog.
schema_notes.load_capacity_note: Static load rating covers total internal component weight. Includes motherboard, GPUs, drives, PSU, and cooling. Exceeding this limit risks rail failure or chassis deformation under vibration.
schema_notes.pdu_note: PDU compatibility refers to standard C13/C14 or C19/C20 IEC rack PDU connections via the chassis PSU inlet. Redundant PSU models typically accept two PDU feeds for failover.
schema_notes.configurator_note: Use max_gpu_length_mm and max_gpu_slot_width fields to validate GPU physical fit. Cross-reference GPU slot_size and length_mm from gpu-catalog.json.

configurator_compatibility_rules_racks._description: GPU rack chassis compatibility rules for the AI PC Configurator feature.

gpu_fit_rules.primary_check: Compare GPU length_mm (from gpu-catalog.json) against rack internal_gpu_clearance_depth_mm. Flag as INCOMPATIBLE if GPU length > clearance.
gpu_fit_rules.slot_width_check: Compare GPU slot_size (1-slot / 2-slot / 3-slot) against rack max_gpu_slot_width. Flag 3-slot GPU in dual-slot-only chassis as WARNING.
gpu_fit_rules.multi_gpu_check: Compare number of GPUs in build against rack max_gpus field. Flag as INCOMPATIBLE if GPU count exceeds max.
gpu_fit_rules.aio_check: If build includes AIO cooler, compare radiator size against rack max_radiator_mm. Flag if radiator exceeds rack support.

motherboard_fit_rules.note: Compare CPU motherboard form factor against rack supported_form_factors. SSI-EEB (Threadripper PRO WRX90) requires chassis explicitly listing SSI-EEB support.
motherboard_fit_rules.critical: Most ATX chassis do NOT support SSI-EEB (330x330mm) — flag as INCOMPATIBLE for Threadripper PRO builds unless SSI-EEB is in supported_form_factors list.

power_rules.note: Sum GPU TDP (from gpu-catalog) + CPU max_turbo_power_watts (from cpu-catalog) + 150W system overhead. Flag if total exceeds rack max_system_power_draw_watts.
power_rules.pdu_rules: Rack pdu_compatibility field lists PDU connection types. Enterprise racks with redundant PSU require dual PDU feeds. Flag single-feed deployments of redundant PSU chassis as sub-optimal.
power_rules.c20_note: Supermicro SC847 requires C20 PDU outlets — standard C14 PDU incompatible with SC847 PSU inlet. Flag mismatch.

depth_rules.note: Rack external chassis depth must be ≤ internal rack cabinet depth. Standard 19-inch 4-post cabinets: 800–1000mm internal depth. Warn if chassis depth > 700mm as deep cabinet required.
depth_rules.deep_rack_flag: SC847 at 790mm requires minimum 1000mm internal rack depth. Flag with 'Deep rack cabinet required' warning.

load_rules.note: Calculate total populated weight: chassis empty weight + (GPU count × avg GPU weight 1.5kg) + (HDD count × 0.7kg) + PSU weight + MB weight + cooling weight. Flag if total approaches static_load_kg limit.

pdu_compatibility_summary.c14_c13_standard: All consumer/prosumer chassis. 10–15A circuits. Standard rack PDU.
pdu_compatibility_summary.c20_c19_high_power: Supermicro SC847, enterprise chassis. 20A circuits. High-density PDU required.
pdu_compatibility_summary.dual_feed: Redundant PSU chassis (SC745TQ, SC847, RM44 mini-redundant). Two independent PDU feeds for A+B power path.
